Modified for AutoVerse: Khronos and 3D Commerce logo textures removed, geometry simplified and meshopt-compressed, textures converted to WebP.

processing: Downloaded glTF-Binary/CarConcept.glb from glTF-Sample-Assets (11,778,688 bytes) to .asset-staging/khronos-carconcept/.
Unpacked to glTF + external PNGs with `gltf-transform copy` (CLI 4.5.1) in .asset-staging/khronos-carconcept/work/.

Trademark removal (logos are excluded from CC BY): emissive_1.png (Khronos logo; License Plate base colour and emissive map of the Hardware, Mirror, Brake, Rim1, Rim2 and one unnamed material) replaced with solid black; baseColor_2.png (Tireside base colour carrying Khronos and 3D Commerce logos) replaced with solid RGB(29,29,29), its own background colour; normal_6.png (Tireside normal map) had the embossed Khronos and 3D Commerce logos flattened to a neutral normal (annulus r 451-503 px at 158-205 deg and -15..15 deg), keeping the generic sidewall markings. Originals kept in .asset-staging/khronos-carconcept/work/original-logo-textures/.

`gltf-transform optimize --join false --flatten false --instance false --palette false --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 2048` (other defaults kept: dedup, weld, simplify error 0.0001, prune incl. solid textures to factors, sparse).

meshopt quantization moved the meshes of 6 parent nodes (BodyUnderside, BodyHood, BodyDoorLColor1, BodyDoorRColor1, BodyRearPanelsColor1, InteriorSteeringCylinder) into new unnamed child nodes; the named parents keep their transforms/pivots and are now groups.

Re-inspected output: all 97 original node names present, hierarchy otherwise unchanged; 12 WebP images extracted and viewed, no logo remains; 213,347 -> 148,222 triangles; 11,778,688 -> 2,336,460 bytes.

framing.upAxis: +Y (root node BodyUnderside rotates the Z-up source -90 deg about X)
framing.notes: Metres. Wheels sit on y = 0. Front faces +Z (Engine and BodyHood are at +Z). Not centred on Z (centre about z = +0.24): centre with Box3 before framing. Pivots, measured in world space from the source file: BodyDoorLColor1/RColor1 pivot at the door's front edge (x +/-1.09, y 0.64, z 1.00), so rotate about Y to open. BodyHood is a front clamshell (mesh z 1.17..2.42, includes headlights) pivoting at its front lower edge (y 0.18, z 2.38): rotate about X to tilt it forward. It is not a windscreen-side bonnet hinge. BodyRearPanelsColor1 is a rear clamshell (mesh z -1.94..-0.46, includes rear hatch, rear window, taillights) pivoting at its rear lower edge (y 0.42, z -1.93). WheelFrontL/FrontR/RearL/RearR are hub-centred groups at y 0.384 (wheel radius about 0.38 m), front axle z 1.49, rear z -1.31. The steering wheel is centrally mounted (x about 0).

assets.notes: Best vehicle-shell asset. Exterior panels are separate, named and have usable pivots (see framing), so the doors can swing open and the front and rear clamshells can tilt open in code. Note that 'bonnet' and 'boot-lid' here are concept-car clamshells (front and rear body sections), not conventional panels. Caveats: (1) Engine is a single fused placeholder mesh with no internals. (2) WheelXxBrakePad (red caliper) is a child of the wheel group, so spinning WheelXx spins the caliper too; re-parent the caliper to the car or spin only the Rim, tyre and disc. (3) Each tyre is an unnamed sibling mesh of WheelXxRim inside WheelXx (materials Tireside/Tiretread), so it cannot be keyed by name; reach it as the unnamed child of WheelXx. (4) BodyHood also contains BodyHeadlights, BodyHoodTopgrill and the hood interior pieces, and BodyRearPanelsColor1 contains the rear hatch, rear window and taillights. Highlighting the group highlights all of them. (5) BodyUnderside is the scene root (a group containing the whole car), so it is deliberately not mapped. (6) Other usable named nodes not mapped (no canonical id yet): Axles (one fused mesh for both axles), InteriorSteeringCylinder (steering wheel group), InteriorSteeringDashColumn, InteriorPedalBrake, InteriorPedalAccel, InteriorSeatsColor1, BodyWindshield, BodyHeadlights, BodyTaillights. (7) No suspension parts. (8) Needs a loader with MeshoptDecoder (drei useGLTF enables it by default) and EXT_texture_webp support (three.js GLTFLoader has it). Material variants (KHR_materials_variants: Carmine Candy, Pearly Swirly, Torched Graphite) are kept but need a variants plugin to switch. Canonical ids follow the research naming; they must exist in src/content/components/<system>.json before <Part> uses them. Not yet rendered in the app.
